Maine yeh check kiya tha:

1. **Session-history database** mein pichhle 7/30 din ke sessions ko repo name, workspace path aur recent sessions ke basis par dhoondha. Repo se match karta koi session nahi mila; local history mein sirf 12 Oct ka unrelated session tha.
2. Phir **session-list tool** se `whisper_flow_hackathon` workspace ke archived sessions dekhe. Wahan 24 Oct (**“purane conversation ka pata”**), 25 Oct (**“purane conversation ki yaad”**) aur current 26 Oct session ke titles aur metadata mile.
3. 24 aur 25 Oct sessions ke liye **conversation-context tool** chalaya—pehle summary, phir full detail; retry mein digest bhi. Har baar transcript khaali aaya: `transcript: []`, `hasMoreHistory: false`, `truncated: false`.

**Main yahin atka:** session listing se pata chala ki sessions maujood hain, lekin context tool ne unke messages nahi diye. Isliye exact chat print ya summarize karne ke liye mere paas content nahi tha. Maine local disk par session files ya VS Code storage ko alag se inspect nahi kiya—mere paas uske liye koi path/tool result nahi tha. Is wajah se exact underlying cause—jaise transcript save nahi hua, ya tool us archived content ko expose nahi kar raha—confirm nahi kar sakta.
